# asc_cluster (Resource)

Manages an OpenShift cluster provisioned by the ASC cluster-service. Provisioning is asynchronous: cluster-service returns immediately after persisting the cluster and continues to install the cluster in the background.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `control_plane` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_plane))
- `domain` (String) Cluster base domain (e.g. "example.com").
- `image` (String) VM image used to boot the cluster nodes.
- `name` (String) Cluster name. Must be unique within the tenant.
- `pull_secret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Pull secret used to render the install-config. Write-only: never stored in state (Terraform >= 1.11).
- `ssh_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SSH public key authorized on the cluster nodes. Write-only: never stored in state (Terraform >= 1.11).
- `version` (String) OpenShift version to install (e.g. "4.16.5").
- `vpc` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc))
- `workers` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workers))

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Customer-managed key/value tags.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Cluster creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Cluster identifier (currently the cluster name).
- `status` (String) Cluster lifecycle status (e.g. "provisioning", "installing", "ready", "error").
- `status_message` (String) Human-readable detail about the current status.
- `urn` (String) URN of the cluster assigned by cluster-service.

Required:

- `replicas` (Number) Number of nodes in the pool. Must be at least 1.
- `sku_id` (String) SKU id sizing the nodes in this pool.
